assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: uncontrolled movement of PSV-4111 during shift handover

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was serious injury requiring hospitalisation, with 2 persons injured and 90 days lost.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-4111 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on PSV-4111 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically performing in-service and hydrostatic inspection. PSV-4111 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during shift handover while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 25 September 2013 an incident occurred on PSV-4111 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during shift handover, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
